descriptions.d24d_open_package_8015c154: Opens a resource package: a path whose lower-cased 4-character suffix is .zip goes through the archive interface found by id 0x80418070 (slot 5), other paths through the manager at +20 (slot 8, mode 1), returning a negative status at once; passes the handle to the store at +16 (slot 12) and returns 0.
